enlightenment.title: Physical Labor
enlightenment.description: Heavy labor and little rest develop your muscles +1 STR

enlightenment.title: Nimble Reflexes
enlightenment.description: Running with a band of rogues or maybe at the circuit with the jugglers sharpen your reflexes +1 DEX

enlightenment.title: Rugged Conditioning
enlightenment.description: Training under a veteran or ex-mercenary, or time spent in harsh terrains, toughens you +1 CON

enlightenment.title: Academic Pursuit
enlightenment.description: Time spent at an university or with a scholar teaches valuable skills and how to apply rational thinking +1 INT

enlightenment.title: Spiritual Guidance
enlightenment.description: A sage or priest schools you in the benefits of faith and strength of mind +1 WIS

enlightenment.title: Charismatic Presence
enlightenment.description: You meet a very charismatic leader or powerful entertainer who teaches you the strength of assertiveness and charm +1 CHR

enlightenment.title: New Strength Talent
enlightenment.description: You are able to learn a new STR skill.

enlightenment.title: Strength Mastery
enlightenment.description: Through lots of practice or much use, one of your STR skills improves.

enlightenment.title: Armor Proficiency

enlightenment.title: Skill Feat
enlightenment.description: You gain a feat (for which you meet the prerequisites) which only improves skill(s).

enlightenment.title: Basic Feat
enlightenment.description: You learn a new Feat that has no prerequisites.

enlightenment.title: General Feat
enlightenment.description: You learn a new General Feat for which you meet the prerequisites.
